summary: Reviewed the exact candidate change against base. The refresh wrapper now appends the rotated hub-session Set-Cookie when the response only sets other cookies, and regression tests cover account password, root, authorize select-account, login prompt, and logout paths. No introduced defects found.

evidence: src/passport.ts:2896-2908 now skips refresh only when a dua_session Set-Cookie is already present, and otherwise appends the rotated cookie alongside other cookies.
tests/bun_test.ts:55-141 exercises the account password, root, authorize select_account and login prompt pages after a touch interval and verifies both cookies are returned plus session/me succeeds.
tests/bun_test.ts:145-181 verifies logout still clears the hub cookie and does not receive a rotated session cookie.
